name: signalbox
description: Signalbox React interface and asset build dependencies.

scripts.lint: eslint resources/js vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts tests/frontend eslint.config.js prettier.config.js scripts --max-warnings=0
scripts.format: prettier --write resources/js resources/css tests/frontend "*.{js,ts}" package.json tsconfig.json "scripts/**/*.mjs"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check resources/js resources/css tests/frontend "*.{js,ts}" package.json tsconfig.json "scripts/**/*.mjs"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run types:check && npm run test:quality
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
